evidence_quotes:
you must use drycleaning solvent (Appendix C,
Item 18) to clean grease or oil from metal parts.
Clean parts with drycleaning solvent (SD), type II, or equivalent.
statements.reason: The general cleaning instruction specifies drycleaning solvent for grease or oil on metal parts; the parts-cleaning instruction specifies SD type II or equivalent.
statements.statement: For general cleaning of grease or oil from metal parts, the specified agent is drycleaning solvent (SD), type II, or equivalent.

evidence_quotes: Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
statements.reason: The CDR-specific caution prohibits cleaning the valve with solvent.
statements.statement: When cleaning the CDR valve, the general choice of solvent for grease or oil on metal parts must not be applied.

evidence_quotes:
Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
This will damage the diaphragm in-
side the CDR valve.
statements.reason: The CDR-specific caution states this consequence.
statements.statement: When cleaning the CDR valve, solvent will damage the diaphragm inside the valve.

evidence_quotes:
Wiping with a rag
is the only authorized method of
cleaning.
c. Remove and wipe off the CDR valve
and hoses with a rag.
statements.reason: The procedure identifies rag wiping as the only authorized method and directs wiping the valve and hoses.
statements.statement: When cleaning the CDR valve, the authorized method is to wipe the valve and its hoses with a rag only.
